sources.title: SaMD Class I (MDR)
sources.why: Defines the lowest MDR Rule 11 risk class, the self-certifiable end of the SaMD classification scale.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIa (MDR)
sources.why: Sets the default Rule 11 class for software informing diagnostic or therapeutic decisions, central to SaMD classification.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIb (MDR)
sources.why: Defines the Rule 11 class where erroneous output could cause serious harm, escalating the SaMD classification.

sources.title: SaMD Class III (MDR)
sources.why: Defines the strictest Rule 11 class for software whose error could cause death or irreversible harm.
